name: Extra Spiritual Boon
body:
You gain another boon from a spirit.

Prerequisite(s): Spiritual boon.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional spiritual boon. However, you still cannot choose a spiritual boon more than once.

Special: You can choose this feat multiple times but you must choose a different spiritual boon each time.
